_comment_layout: Reference workflow spec — load with serde_json into tenzro_workflow::Workflow. workflow_id and gate_id are 32-byte hash arrays; placeholders here MUST be re-derived at load time. Accompanied by environmental_mrv_daml_map.json.
_comment_scenario: Environmental MRV (Monitoring / Reporting / Verification) for a carbon-credit issuance: project developer's monitoring agent emits sensor + satellite-derived measurements, an independent verifier signs a TEE attestation that the data pipeline ran inside an attested enclave, the registrar issues the resulting credit batch as a tokenized Pay obligation back to the developer's wallet. Two-of-three governance approval (registrar + verifier + standards-body) before any credits mint.
creator: did:tenzro:human:project-developer:1
title: environmental_mrv
description: Verifiable Monitoring/Reporting/Verification flow for carbon-credit issuance. TEE-attested data pipeline + multi-party governance gate.

_obligation_records._comment: Monitoring leg: project developer's bot publishes the raw measurement bundle as an attestation pointing at the bundle hash.
Verification leg: independent verifier's TEE pipeline produces a hardware-attested verification report. Discharge requires a TEE attestation matching the verifier's enclave identity.
Issuance leg: registrar mints CARBON tokens (1 tCO2e per token) to the developer's wallet.

approval_gates._comment_id: Derived at load time via ApprovalGate::derive_id(workflow_id, 'pre_issuance_governance').

_comment_privacy_domain: Set at load time. Visibility = MembersPlusAuditors so the public-registry-mirror and standards-body receive unredacted measurement + verification bundles for transparency.
_comment_fee_route: Set at load time. Suggested split on the issuance leg: 70% project-developer, 15% independent-verifier (verification fee), 10% carbon-registrar (issuance fee), 5% standards-body (governance fee). Network fee 0.5% applied at base layer.
